No part stands up from the ground, so there is no front face of 3 or more rows. The whole drawing reads as a flat plate seen from above, which suits the flat kind.

styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate is a small isolated sprite (about one tile or less) on a dark backdrop, not a continuous 4x3 ground patch like the grass and paving references. The references show a full ground texture across the whole area (grass tufts, per-stone shading), and the candidate does not. When in doubt, fail.
